cna.headline: Leao bids emotional farewell to Milan amid reports of Galatasaray switch
cna.teaser: Leao bids emotional farewell to Milan amid reports of Galatasaray switch
fullText: Aug 29 : Portugal winger Rafael Leao bid an emotional farewell to AC Milan amid reports he is close to joining Turkish side Galatasaray, saying the decision was difficult but that he would always remain part of the Rossoneri's history.

A product of Sporting Portugal's academy, the 27-year-old has been capped 49 times by his country and represented Portugal at the 2022 and 2026 World Cups. He joined Milan from French side Lille in 2019.

Leao became a key figure for the seven-time European champions, scoring 80 goals and providing 65 assists in 291 appearances across all competitions. He helped Milan win the Serie A title in 2021-22 and the Italian Super Cup in the 2024-25 season.
According to media reports, Milan have accepted a €45 million ($52.12 million) offer from Galatasaray for Leao, whose contract with the Italian club runs until June 2028.

"Milan helped me grow and understand what top-flight football is all about. The time has come to say goodbye. I might have liked to say goodbye in a different way. The fans supported me even during the tough times.
"I know what I've achieved here; I'll go down in the club's history. All I can do is say thank you."
Milan appointed former Manchester United coach Ruben Amorim as manager in June after a disappointing campaign last season that saw them miss out on Champions League qualification.
They have since made a strong start to the new Serie A season, winning their opening two matches.
"My love for Milan will never end; even from afar, I'll always be watching them...," Leao added.
"There are times when you have to make a decision and choose a different path.
"Today, Milan showed great quality and have a great manager. He's someone who can help Milan win major trophies. It's the sort of football I like...
"Life doesn't end here. I cried; I was moved."
A single handpicked story that we think you shouldn't miss. Just one a day.

economistArticle.title: The Price of Closed Gates: Trump’s Immigration Crackdown and the Threat to American Growth
paras: In the theater of modern populist politics, few promises resonate quite as fiercely as the pledge to seal national borders and repatriate undocumented workers. Yet, as the rhetoric around immigration intensifies ahead of the upcoming US election, economists are raising alarm bells over the stark fiscal reality of such policies. A sweeping crackdown on immigration, championed by Donald Trump, threatens to trigger a profound demographic contraction that could hobble the American economy for a generation.

The mechanics of this economic drag are straightforward but devastating. For decades, the American labor force has relied on a steady influx of foreign-born workers to offset the natural aging of its domestic population. By curtailing both legal visas and executing mass deportations, the proposed policies would abruptly sever this vital supply line. Key sectors—ranging from agriculture and hospitality to technology and healthcare—would find themselves grappling with acute, systemic labor shortages that cannot easily be plugged by native-born workers.

Beyond the immediate disruption to specific industries, the macroeconomic fallout would be pervasive. Economists estimate that a significant reduction in foreign labor would trigger a sharp contraction in GDP growth, while simultaneously stoking inflationary pressures. As businesses compete for a dwindling pool of workers, wage growth in low-productivity sectors might spike temporarily, but this would inevitably be passed on to consumers in the form of higher prices. The ultimate result is a stagflationary trap: slower growth paired with stubborn inflation.

Furthermore, the long-term fiscal health of the United States depends heavily on immigration to sustain its social safety nets. The Social Security and Medicare systems rely on the payroll taxes of active workers to fund the retirement benefits of an aging baby-boomer generation. Stripping millions of productive, tax-paying individuals from the economy would severely exacerbate the funding shortfalls of these programs. Far from protecting domestic wealth, a draconian immigration policy risks bankrupting the very institutions designed to safeguard it.

Ultimately, the pursuit of absolute border control at the expense of economic pragmatism represents a classic case of political expediency overriding fiscal sanity. In an era where global competitiveness is defined by human capital, restricting the flow of labor is akin to unilateral economic disarmament. If America chooses to shutter its gates, it must also prepare to accept a less dynamic, slower-growing future, sacrificing its economic preeminence on the altar of populist ideology.
economistArticle.cn:
在现代民粹主义政治的舞台上，很少有哪项承诺能像封闭国家边界和遣返无证劳工那样，引起如此强烈的共鸣。然而，随着大选临近、关于移民问题的言辞日益激烈，经济学家们正对这些政策背后的残酷财政现实敲响警钟。唐纳德·特朗普所倡导的全面移民打击政策，极有可能引发严重的人口萎缩，从而使美国经济在整整一代人的时间里步履维艰。

这种经济拖累的机制简单却具有毁灭性。几十年来，美国劳动力市场一直依赖源源不断的外籍员工，来抵消本土人口自然老龄化的影响。通过削减合法签证和执行大规模遣返，拟议的政策将突然切断这条至关重要的供应线。从农业、服务业到科技和医疗保健等关键行业，都将面临严重的、系统性的劳动力短缺，而这些缺口是无法轻易由本土工人填补的。

除了对特定行业的直接冲击外，宏观经济的负面连锁反应也将无处不在。经济学家估计，外籍劳动力的重大流失将导致国内生产总值（GDP）增长急剧萎缩，同时加剧通胀压力。随着企业争夺日益减少的劳动力资源，低生产率部门的工资涨幅可能会出现暂时性飙升，但这必然会以更高商品价格的形式转嫁给消费者。最终的结果将是一个滞胀陷阱：增长放缓与顽固通胀并存。

此外，美国的长期财政健康在很大程度上取决于依靠移民来维持其社会安全保障网。社会保障和医疗保险体系依赖在职职工缴纳的工资税，来为老龄化的婴儿潮一代筹集退休福利资金。将数百万有生产力、有纳税能力的个人从经济体中剥离出去，将严重加剧这些计划的资金缺口。严酷的移民政策非但不能保护国内财富，反而有可能使旨在保障财富的制度走向破产。

归根结底，以牺牲经济务实态度为代价去追求绝对的边界控制，是政治权宜之计压倒财政理性的典型案例。在一个人力资本决定全球竞争力的时代，限制劳动力流动无异于单方面解除经济武装。如果美国选择关闭大门，它就必须准备好接受一个活力减弱、增长放缓的未来，将自己的经济主导地位牺牲在民粹主义意识形态的祭坛上。

gems.why: It uses a powerful military metaphor ('unilateral economic disarmament') to frame an economic policy in dramatic, high-stakes terms, illustrating the self-inflicted damage of restrictive policies. 在一个以人力资本定义全球竞争力的时代，限制劳动力流动无异于单方面解除经济武装。该句使用了强有力的军事隐喻（‘单方面解除经济武装’）来描述经济政策，生动展现了限制性政策对国家自身造成的伤害。

gems.s: Ultimately, the pursuit of absolute border control at the expense of economic pragmatism represents a classic case of political expediency overriding fiscal sanity.
gems.why: This sentence employs excellent balanced phrasing, contrasting 'political expediency' with 'fiscal sanity' to highlight the irrationality of the policy. 最终，以牺牲经济务实为代价追求绝对边界控制，是政治权宜之计压倒财政理性的典型案例。该句采用工整的对照结构，将‘政治权宜’与‘财政理性’对立，有力揭示了政策的非理性本质。
